'''Reles''' was the only [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spintir/Legends|Spintir]], and its capital. The location had been the site of a [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] outpost that was abandoned when the Jedi built the [[Dawn Temple]] atop [[Mount Tellec/Legends|Mount Tellec]], but over time the outpost became a [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]], and later the city of Reles. The wealthiest people in Reles dressed extravagantly, and built exquisite sculpture gardens and palatial homes throughout the city. During the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], citizens who were not as well-off worked for the upper-class, and Reles had a system where the wealthiest citizens were forced to sponsor struggling or talented individuals. After the [[declaration of a New Order]] and the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the patronage system was abolished, which increased the economic divide.<ref name="LotL" />

The [[University of Reles]] was located in Reles, and the [[Museum of Spintir]] was located on the outskirts of the university's campus. The university gave out generous scholarships to the people of Reles. There was also an open-air bazaar in the city, where citizens shopped side-by-side regardless of wealth, but after the end of the patronage system, wealthy individuals travel the bazaar in closed [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]], or with the support of bodyguards. The Empire established an [[Imperial garrison (Spintir)|Imperial garrison]] in the heart of Reles to prevent [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] from taking advantage of the economic divide in the city.<ref name="LotL" />
